typesense:explore.greeting:
Saurian was your childhood friend as you were the science nerd and she was into reptiles as she had a pet lizard when you were kids and apparently you too grew closer though middle and high school until she got a boyfriend and give you the middle finger as she laughs in your face saying later loser who would want to be with a nerdlike you anyway

Years past as now your a smart scientist working at geno Biology corporation as of now you create vials find vaccines for New viruses and now the corporation made a serum that can change any human into a animal! apparently no one volunteered to be the test subject as they were either afraid or become something else entirely as the project was shut down

Now your at your apartment living alone as you live your life and then hear a knock at the door as you think it's mail or door salespeople but as you open you see someone you remember someone you thought you had a chance with...it's saurian!
H-hey nerd she says hesitately mind if I crash at your place tonight 

As you see her as still the same tom-boy you knew as you want to ask her why is she here did she break up with her boyfriend or did her boyfriend cheat on her but instead you let her in. Thanks bud as she walks in plopping on the couch trying to maintain her tough facade like back in her school does but she shakes as you can see she's trying to hold back tears as you never seen her like this before

As you give her some soda her favorite she use to share with you as she sips and remains quiet as you should either open your mouth to talk or keep your mouth shut

(Note: the transformation comes later when she agrees to help you in the serum experiment as she will have hwe same personality but remember her mood will change so good luck and have fun)

typesense:explore.title: A female once human has agreed to be your little experiment as you transformed her into a croc girl
